why: Both analyses land on the same banking and accounting automation hedgehog, reject the head-on fight with Rival I, cover all three key brutal facts and read the new EVP as a Level 4 'genius with a thousand helpers', but neither warns against cost cuts that starve engineering and service. Analysis 2 edges ahead with a denominator closer to the key (profit per installed account), more explicit succession and field-support safeguards against one-man dependence, and a tighter, more actionable verdict.
